name: After recital C
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on narco-trafficking in Europe’s waters: protecting our borders and supporting our law enforcement officers
part_text: Ca. whereas on 8 May 2026, two officers of the Guardia Civil Maritime Service lost their lives, and two others were injured, while pursuing a narco-boat off the coast of Huelva, Spain; whereas this tragedy follows the deaths of two Guardia Civil officers on 9 February 2024 when their vessel was rammed by a narco-boat in the port of Barbate; whereas in 2024, Spain seized 124 tonnes of cocaine, more than any other Member State and accounting for over a third of all cocaine seized in the EU that year; whereas in April 2026, the Guardia Civil seized more than 30 tonnes of cocaine in a single operation at sea; whereas criminal networks are increasingly relying on go-fast boats, at-sea transfers, semi-submersibles and drones, and are resorting more frequently to violence;
